title: Handed a gold sceptre with DNA carving in shop, what is it?
content: Hey guys, last night I was in a shop in a suburban/overgrown part of mallworld i hadn't been to before, I entered it in a lift from the ground floor main mall. In this shop was lots of different crystals, like a gem shop but but very luxurious. I go to the counter and there's a girl and we are talking, about what is blurry now but I can see she's holding something under the counter so I asked to see it. She looked up at me really shocked and said 'I can't believe you can see it I've never got to hand it to anyone before' and she hands me this heavy gold sceptre spirit stick thing (I'm sorry I'm an ex cheerleader and I have nothing else to compare it to). On the sides are carved the DNA snake symbols and I feel a button on the side and turn it on and it starts glowing and lighting the shop up with some sort of crystal projections/3D shit, kinda like when you get a rainbow from glass but it was more solid. Then I wake. Wtf is this thing and has anyone else seen it in mallworld?
